mainEntity.name: Looking for a top website developer in Delhi? How does Xunique Labs deliver?

acceptedAnswer.text: Xunique Labs is a Delhi-based software and website development studio. Unlike typical agencies that outsource or use bloated templates, we handcraft precision-engineered, responsive websites, Next.js web applications, and custom software designed to load under 1 second and rank high on search engines.

mainEntity.name: Why choose Xunique Labs over standard web development agencies?

acceptedAnswer.text: At Xunique Labs, your project is architected and built directly by senior engineers without intermediary account managers or bloated code. We deliver custom-coded solutions with zero unnecessary dependencies, guaranteed sub-second loading speeds, and full source code ownership.

mainEntity.name: What is the cost of website development in Delhi?

acceptedAnswer.text: We offer transparent, competitive pricing: Starter landing pages start at ₹1,999/- (1–2 days delivery), 5-page Business Websites are ₹7,999/-, and full-featured E-Commerce Stores are ₹9,999/-. For complex SaaS, web apps, and mobile applications, we provide custom milestone-based pricing.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide mobile app development alongside web development?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Xunique Labs specializes in both mobile, web, and app dev. We engineer cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android using Flutter and React Native, seamlessly synchronized with cloud backends (Firebase, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase) and custom REST/GraphQL APIs.

mainEntity.name: How do you ensure websites and apps rank on Google?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every website we build includes on-page SEO optimization: clean semantic HTML5, Schema.org JSON-LD structured data, Core Web Vitals optimization (100/100 Lighthouse performance), mobile responsiveness, Open Graph social tags, and automated XML sitemaps.

mainEntity.name: How can we start a project with Xunique Labs?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can reach out via our contact form on xuniquelabs.com, dispatch an email to support@xuniquelabs.com, or message us directly on WhatsApp at +91 74588 45252 for instant project scoping.
